sloka: खुरैरुदीरितो रेणुर्दिवं प्रच्छाद्य तिष्ठति ।तं वहत्यनिल: शीघ्रं कुर्वन्निव मम प्रियम् ॥ २.९३.१५॥
transliteration: khurairudīrito reṇurdivaṁ pracchādya tiṣṭhati ।taṁ vahatyanila: śīghraṁ kurvanniva mama priyam ॥ 2.93.15॥

translations.english: While the dust kicked by the hooves of the horses enveloped the forest, the wind, as if to please me, is quickly blowing them away.
